name: Imouto no Nureta Ana wa Ore no Mono
original_name: 妹の濡れた穴は俺のモノ
source:
Rina is my cute, kind of sassy little sister.
Lately she's starting to look like a sassy young woman.
One night I caught her masturbating.
That was the moment I could not longer be just her brother. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE184070.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
莉娜是我可爱、又有点任性的妹妹。

最近，她开始越来越像一个任性的年轻女人。

某晚，我撞见她自慰。

从那一刻起，我再也无法只把她当妹妹。
